scope: Independent all400 physical source/ownership/projection/token-offset audit of exposed original development references; no regrading/causal claim/fit/inference/private reserve or source/result edits.
limits: The mapper covers physical lines in OwnerDescription.implementation (the body), while the actual implementation projection also has a synthetic identity/signature header. Missing mapped declaration lines may already be represented by that same view header, and documentation may exist in contract/fullowner. Thus60 missing-body-anchor cases do not prove missing text from the implementation input or the index;47 are already strict hits.
Full decisive lines inside the prefix are neither semantic understanding nor a causal demonstration of ordering failure; lines outside it do not establish that more windows improve ranking.

The registered tokenizer lowercases and normalizes text; this test maps physical source character endpoints into the truncated projection, not lossless reproduction of every source character as tokens.
Gaps and missing declaration/documentation remain explicit; null alternatives enumerate same-file owners individually and do not compose distinct owners.
Whitespace-only anchored lines are counted by their endpoint as in the protocol; none changes a full-owner classification if treated vacuously visible.
This diagnostic uses development references and outcomes after existing controls. It is not a label-free producer, held-out estimate or achievable-accuracy upper bound.
